8.1.4
AUTHORITY TO PROVIDE DEVELOPMENT CHARGE CREDITS AND/OR REIMBURSEMENTS TO BERCZY ELGIN HOLDINGS INC.
S. Sultan, ext. 2629 / T. Chiu, ext. 3013 / S. MacKenzie, ext. 2205
That the report entitled “Authority to Provide Development Charge Credits and/or Reimbursements to Berczy Elgin Holdings Inc.” be received; and,
That Council authorize City-Wide Hard Development Charge Credits and/or Reimbursement in the amount of $16,808,376 or the actual cost of construction, whichever is the lesser, to Berczy Elgin Holdings Inc. for the design, contract administration, and construction costs associated with the construction of the proposed Berczy Water Infrastructure which will service lands in the Berczy Glen Secondary Plan area, including the lands north of Elgin Mills Road as follows:
Pressure District 7 (“PD7”) Water Booster Pumping Station (“WBS”) on the lands owned by Berczy Elgin Holdings Inc.; and,
600mm concrete pressure pipe (“CPP”) watermain within the proposed Thomas Lynch Street from Elgin Mills Road East to the south limit of the subdivision 19TM-1801 (the "CPP Internal Watermain"); and,
600mm CPP watermain within the proposed Stony Hill Boulevard from the south limit of the subdivision 19TM-18010 to Warden Avenue and along Warden Avenue from the proposed Stony Hill Boulevard to the existing watermain at Vine Cliff Boulevard (the “CPP External Watermain”); and,
That Council authorize City Wide Hard Development Charge credits and/or Reimbursement in the amount of $778,151 or the actual cost, whichever is the lesser, to Berczy Elgin Holdings Inc. relating to its portion of the property acquisition and construction costs associated with that portion of the right-of-way of Thomas Lynch Street from Elgin Mills Road East to the south limit of the subdivision 19TM-18010, that exceeds 23 metres in width; and,
That notwithstanding the above recommendations, the amount available for credits and/or reimbursement shall be based on the lesser of the actual cost to construct and the capital cost included in the most current Development Charges Background Study, as indexed from time to time, at the time the works are complete and the credits and/or reimbursements are being provided; and,
That all of the above credits and/or reimbursements shall exclude HST and interest and shall be indexed in accordance with the City’s Development Charge Credit and Reimbursement Policy; and,
That the Mayor and Clerk be authorized to execute a Development Charge Credit and/or Reimbursement Agreement or other agreement, if required, in accordance with the City’s Development Charge Credit and Reimbursement Policy, with Berczy Elgin Holdings Inc. or their successors in title, to the satisfaction of the Treasurer and the City Solicitor; and,
That the Mayor and Clerk be authorized to execute a ground lease agreement with Berczy Elgin Holdings Inc. or their successors in title, for the City’s lease of the lands required for the maintenance and operation of the WBS on terms satisfactory to the Director of Engineering in a form satisfactory to the City Solicitor and the Commissioner of Development Services; and further,
That Staff be authorized and directed to do all things necessary to give effect to this resolution, including the execution of documents.
